status: Predeclared before V3 experiment scores; V1/V2 scores historical only
preprocessing_panels: Two 32-row native panels centered in gaps after V2 chronological slots 1 and 2; full wavelengths for diagnostics, 256-column subpanels for controlled fitting. First gap development, second confirmation. Wavelength location 0.66 of available span avoids V1 local 0.25-0.50 spectral patch.
model_panels: Two 32x256 native panels in gaps after V2 slots 0 and 4; wavelength positions 0.28 and 0.65. Disjoint from all V2 local panels and preprocessing panels. Raw heats previously studied: new mask confirmation, not external validation.
frame_candidate_rule: leave-current-frame-out +/-2 time references; relative brightness >=max(0.20,6*MAD log-integral); angle>=max(5deg,median+6MAD); shape or cross-fit rank residual robust z>=6; exact flat/nonfinite separately flagged. Statistical candidates never confirmed faults.
policy_selection: P4 sensitivity only. No automatic real whole-frame deletion without confirmed evidence. Compare P0,P2,P3 on development only. Added processing requires >=5% heat-macro NRMSE reduction vs P0, no scenario >10% deterioration, real-point masking <=1%, and no more than 1% raw peak p95 change on unmasked original-valid reference. Otherwise P0. P1/P2 equal if no structurally/externally confirmed rows; P2 supplies diagnosis ledger. P3 weights must enter loss.
confirmation_not_tuning: Preprocessing confirmation and final-model confirmation never alter selected policy, rank, eta or guards.
guard: At invalid/missing non-saturated cells, constrain low-rank estimate to min/max of nearest visible recorded observations along time and wavelength (including visible saturation codes). If no axial support, use global visible range and mark weak support. This is an optimization projection before interpolation, never plotting clipping.
candidate_selection: Lexicographic physical gates before heat-macro missing NRMSE, then cost; candidate names V1,V2,V3-A,V3-B,V3-C. V3-C adds local box/nonnegative guards to V3-A and recorded saturation retention. Sparse term retained only as bounded-influence fit if C needed; report B comparison without asserting significant sparse benefit.
stability_rule: Compare protected output at 600 and 1200; do not loosen iteration tolerance. If finite-iterate protected missing prediction RMS exceeds 65.535, replace individually unstable (>65.535) cells by visible-only two-axis linear fill, mark numerical fallback, report approximation. Raw latent convergence status always retained.

conditional_saturation.method: existing convex nuclear ADMM on fixed tiles with halos, separable local objectives; not a global nuclear solution
conditional_saturation.scope: All saturated cells in all eight heats covered; keep per-tile residual/budget quality and unknown true upper bound

quality_scoring: Only scoring uses finite 0<Y<64000; also report all unsaturated reference, never use hidden true values for training masks/weights/support. Original observations noisy.
accuracy_acceptance: Protected final-model heat-macro NRMSE <=1.25 times visible-only bidirectional linear baseline on new confirmation; failure is reported, not tuned away.
compute_scope: Finite candidates, no C/B5/BEADS search. Full native final fits; small new-region confirmation. Existing artificial-clipping results reused plus one fixed 80th percentile cap check per heat.
